scope: Independent final raw-result, source-custody and report arithmetic review after completed procedural and independent code/Rust/security gates. No production edits, tests, builds or measurement reruns.
method: Read all six registered plans and raw nested session records; join ordered scopes, fixture lengths/object/SHA identities, exact reopen rows and receiver JSON events. Preserve POLICY log preambles. Recompute each setup+seed+update lifecycle from disjoint phases, all min/median/p95/max distributions and all trial-paired ratios/geometric means/wins/ties. No new analyzer project.
reviewed_findings: Exact evaluated costs and conservative pruned bounds remain distinct: 16MiB Whole bound896, 1MiB Whole bound536, cold schema target547+actual seed670. All60 selections retain actual600-byte Sparse transfer, with no schema seed or hidden retry.

Every selector session pays actual512-record training construction/fitting and context setup once. Lifecycle sender CPU includes setup; total CPU adds disjoint receiver-handler CPU once. Exchange timing remains nested, not pure wire time.

The report correctly distinguishes ratios of cohort medians, medians of paired ratios and geometric means. Small selector/Sparse median paired sender CPU is1.432347; geometric mean1.451143 is a different statistic. Small paid selector/Whole median paired CPU is1.056483; geometric mean1.038367 and ratio of medians1.037426 are distinct.

All180 actual paid base seeds and180 absent-target updates pass exact stopped-store readback. Six permutations of the three arms appear five times per size. No dropped failure or warmup deletion is present.
Report source pins, Linux/Mac feature distinction, failure-preserving evidence index and quantitative limits are consistent with inspected records.
preserved_negatives_limits: At1MiB, selector sender CPU exceeds forced Sparse in all30 pairs; selector paid-lifecycle CPU exceeds Whole in20/30 pairs. No claim of a universal CPU win.

The sole selector/Whole update wall loss is1MiB trial22:279.669ms versus224.304ms; selector exchange277.959ms and receiver-handler elapsed54.732ms do not establish the cause. It remains in all aggregates.

The1MiB ratio of completion medians is1.91x, below the original proposed2x target. At16MiB selector and forced Sparse are approximately equal; small timing differences do not establish a selector speedup over Sparse.

Measured bytes are HTTP request+response bodies, not complete network-path bytes. CPU is an endpoint subtotal, not machine or relay energy. This localized-edit unshaped relay campaign does not qualify arbitrary workloads, conventional-delta superiority, complete WAN acceptance, MVM or CUI/FIPS deployment.
publication_verdict: No blocking source, Rust, security-chain or result/report consistency issue. Results approval is complete; operational cleanup and final checksum publication remain parent-owned separate receipts.
